## Commands (in order)

State variables are set by an environment script (names in the manifest; values are local paths). The replay stage needs the stored fits and replays of the earlier studies (`COMPETITIVE_STATE`, `IMPROVE_STATE`, …).

```
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0 AGENTDOJO_RUNS=/home/user/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/runs PROGENT_UPSTREAM=<progent checkout> \
       COMPETITIVE_STATE=<dir> IMPROVE_STATE=<dir> AUTHZ_STATE=<dir> INTEGRATION_STATE=<dir> PILOT_RESULTS_DIR=<dir>
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/run_ledger_analysis.py            # frozen arms on development scenarios
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/fit_threshold.py                  # θ from development scores only
python3 -m pytest tests/test_architecture_redesign.py -q                    # 15 tests
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/arch_run.py replay scripted suites fixtures cost report
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/amendment1_posthoc.py             # POST-HOC (08a)
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/endpoint_supplement.py            # pre-specified REM-A − C1 endpoint (08a Note 3)
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/export_heldout_calls.py           # held-out restricted calls for the parity check
REM_ALLOW_UPSTREAM_EXECUTION=1 SECAGENT_POLICY_MODEL=none <progent venv>/bin/python \
        experiments/improvement_controlled/parity_recorded_calls.py \
        REM_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN_STUDY_2026_11_18/results/heldout_restricted_calls.json \
        REM_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN_STUDY_2026_11_18/results/progent_parity_heldout_calls.json   # 662 calls, 0 disagreements
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/make_figures.py
python3 experiments/architecture_redesign/manifest.py REM_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN_STUDY_2026_11_18/manifests/reproducibility_manifest.json
```

## Not reproducible from this repository alone
- The **state directories** (stored fits and earlier replays) live in the session scratchpad. They are regenerated by the earlier studies' runners, as listed in their own manifests.
- `results/scripted_closed_loop.json` (14.5 MB) and `episode_outcomes.jsonl.gz` are committed. The replay pickle `arch_replays.pkl` is not committed (state directory).
- There is no live-model or full-Progent result to reproduce (`13`, `12`).
